params.caption: 🎮 Ex-Nintendo marketers: a Majora's Mask remake is a "foregone conclusion" Former Nintendo marketing leads say that after the Ocarina of Time remake, a remake of The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask is all but certain, adding that Nintendo has "probably already started making it".
